instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve strictly the visual design, hierarchy, card styling, and color tokens from the approved Google Stitch reference HTML.
Implement the 8 real routes using react-router-dom in App.tsx (/, /investigacoes, /investigacoes/:id, /central-educativa, /guia-verificacao, /laboratorio, /metodologia, /sobre, and * for 404).

Centralize rich structured mock data for 8+ investigative cases (with complete dossiers, viral claims, 3 pistas with icons, scientific consensus, verdict explanations, and SUS/OMS references) in a dedicated data file like src/data/investigations.ts.

On inner pages that are in development (like certain advanced lab modules or future trilhas), maintain visual polish with themed 'Módulo em Expansão / Prova Didática' cards that explain the upcoming scientific topics without feeling broken or empty.
Support both Material Symbols (via class 'material-symbols-outlined' or Lucide React equivalent icons) ensuring visual consistency across all pages.
Include the demonstrative educational disclaimer clearly on case details and footer without obstructing the educational flow.

Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-investigacoes', data-testid='case-card-101', data-testid='btn-assume-case-101', data-testid='verdict-submit-button').
